name: A Baying of Gnolls
summary: Gnolls have reached Verner Osgood’s stable in Lakeshire, where Blackrock orcs already threaten the region. Verner asks you to drive away the brutes and mystics that endanger his horses.

sections.title: Horses on the Ridge
sections.body: Verner Osgood’s stable in Lakeshire has grown dangerous to tend. Blackrock orcs hold the heights, while gnoll packs roam the ridges around town. Now gnoll raiders have reached the northern edge of Verner’s paddocks. They prey on horses that stray too close to the bluffs.

sections.title: A Coordinated Menace
sections.body: North of Lakeshire, gnoll packs wield brute force and primitive spellcraft. Their brutes overwhelm their prey, while mystics turn wild magic against trespassers. Thinning their numbers gives the settlement a brief respite. Yet the gnolls’ aggression points to a greater power higher in the hills.

faq.q: Why does Verner Osgood need help with gnolls?
faq.answer: Gnolls from the northern ridges have begun reaching Verner’s stables and snatching horses that stray from the paddocks. With Blackrock orcs threatening the region too, he cannot protect his stock alone.
Redridge brutes and mystics prowl the elevated ridges and foothills directly north and east of Lakeshire. From there, they overlook the town and the road toward the Everstill Bridge.

faq.q: Why are gnolls an issue alongside the Blackrock orcs?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs are Redridge’s main military threat, and local gnoll packs take advantage of the distraction. Lakeshire’s defenders are stretched thin, while Stormwind sends few reinforcements. So the predators range as far as the village perimeter.

faq.q: What comes after dealing with these gnolls?
aliases: what next after baying of gnolls
faq.answer: Even after the brutes and mystics are thinned, howling continues in the hills. It points to a greater leadership threat in the surrounding heights.

Redridge mystics use rudimentary nature and elemental magic. Their erratic, feral incantations make them dangerous to trespassers. Among the brutes, they suggest an organized clan rather than lone scavengers.

faq.q: Is Stormwind sending soldiers to protect Lakeshire's stables?
faq.answer: No. Stormwind’s royal court has left Redridge largely to defend itself amid political turmoil and troop shortages. Magistrate Solomon and citizens like Verner Osgood must recruit wandering adventurers.

angles.text: Stormwind’s neglect strains small communities across the southern kingdom. Tradesmen like Verner must hire private help to protect essential supply lines.
As a hunter, you face wild beasts and feral packs in Redridge that have grown bold without organized culls. They threaten domestic animals and travelers.
